notes.title: Update notes for V4.0.0
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]This major update adds configuration options for volume of sound and enable/disable of features (configuration is accessed via the guide). Plus: three new 3D models of sculptures; images of woven silk pictures; various bug fixes & enhancements.[/p][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Narration was missing from Tann Safe (Guide: Manufactures > Safes > Tann & Sons > Fire-proof safe).[/p][/*][*][p]Narration was missing from the arms of Mecklenburg-Strelitz[/p][/*][*][p]Remove erroneous narration from planters[/p][/*][/list][p]Corrections[/p][list][*][p]The narration for Baily’s Eve at the Fountain no longer erroneously reports the piece as lost. (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Baily, Edward H > Eve at the Fountain).[/p][/*][*][p]Corrections to the narration for the flags of Rome, Sardinia and Tuscany[/p][/*][/list][p]Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Narration improved for cast iron version of Eagle Slayer (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Bell, John > Eagle Slayer: cast iron).[/p][/*][*][p]Statue of Dr Goodall is now a 3D model & narration improved (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Weekes, Henry > Dr Goodall).[/p][/*][*][p]The lower ventilators in the ground floor outside wall panels have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]The image of Prometheus by Manning has been replaced by a better quality image (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Manning, Samuel (II) > Prometheus Chained).[/p][/*][*][p]The narration for the Greek Slave has been improved (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Powers, Hiram > Greek Slave).[/p][/*][*][p]Optimisations to reduce disk size and run time memory requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]Some text in Guide abbreviated (long text strings were displaying too small).[/p][/*][/list][p]Additions[/p][list][*][p]A new configuration section has been added to the Guide. This allows the setting of a master volume level, and the relative volume of ambience and fountain water sounds. It also allows the various illustrations (the purple signage boards) to be hidden if not required. In VR mode it also allows selection of ‘superhero teleportation’ – in this mode it is possible to teleport from gallery to ground floor without going via a staircase. The settings are retained between sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Woven Silk pictures by Francois Michel-Marie Carquillat (Guide: Manufactures > Silk > Carquillat > Woven pictures).[/p][/*][*][p]Woven Silk pictures by Potton Rambaud & Co. (Guide: Manufactures > Silk > Potton Rambaud & Co. > Woven pictures).[/p][/*][*][p]Bronze version of Eagle Slayer (previously a second copy of the cast iron version was used at this location) (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Bell, John > Eagle Slayer: bronze).[/p][/*][*][p]Victory by George Nelson (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Nelson, George > Victory).[/p][/*][*][p]Two new watercolours have been added looking from the gallery at the NW of the transept. One looking East along the nave, one looking towards the main (South) entrance.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Follow our Facebook Group to keep apprised of developments: [url="https://www.facebook.com/groups/481745944735839"]https://www.facebook.com/groups/481745944735839[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Our latest YouTube video looks at these additions: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/xBlave4kDBM"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update notes for V3.0.1
notes.notes:
This is a major update, but for technical reasons I was unable to post it as such...

The most significant change this update is the addition of a Guide (currently containing 372 entries). When an entry is selected the user is immediately transported to the location of the selected item. The appropriate control to call the Guide is labelled on the hand controllers in VR mode; press the ‘G’ key in non-VR mode.

In addition…

Bug Fixes:
•	Eastern Waiting Room walls (North side of open court) previously did not generate shadows.
Corrections:
•	Tempest Prognosticator moved to correct location (described in Routledge’s Guide). (Guide: Manufactures > Clocks, watches, barometers > George Merryweather > Tempest Prognosticator).
•	Coat of arms of Bolton replaces that of Barnsley (extreme West of South side of nave) to match photograph.
Improvements:
•	The Mother by Foley is now a 3D model (Western nave). (Guide: Fine Arts > Sculpture > Foley, John Henry > The Mother).
•	In the Sheffield Court the banners on the E, S & W walls have been enhanced to better match various illustrations.
•	Ends of flat roof glazing now properly terminated.
 Additions:

•	Exhibition razor by Thomas Turton and Sons (Sheffield Court). (Guide: Manufactures > Scissors, Penknives & Razors > William Greaves (Thomas Turton & Sons) > Exhibition razor).

notes.title: Update notes for V 1.1.1 (7 Oct 2024)
notes.notes:
A few fixes & enhancements reacting to some early review comments, plus several corrections, improvements & additions:
Bug Fixes
•	Narration  for John Deed Leather skin now works. 
•	Narration & video systems now interact with each other (starting one stops other). 
•	Non-VR mode now always has focus on start up.
•	Non-VR mode when moving fast can no longer break through gallery railing. 
Corrections
•	Adjust position of Great Hydraulic Press, Nasmyth Steam Hammer and some flags & illustrations.
•	Adjust partitions to better match illustrations (including removal of excess partitions from Machinery in Motion sections). 
•	Swap locations of The Unhappy Child and The Infant Moses (Belgium section, middle of East nave)
•	Signs above refreshment room doors now match illustrations.
Improvements
•	Operating narration trigger when not pointing at a narration target stops any in progress narration. 
•	Make grey glass less transparent.
•	Improve gallery canvas ceiling model
•	Improve floorboard  texture
•	Several photographs and watercolours replaced with better quality versions. 
•	Murmur sound loop inside building is longer & quieter 
•	Wording of some statue labels & narrations improved
•	Improve & simplify the Queen Victoria / Thorneycroft model (North transept)
•	Zinc statue of Queen Victoria narration now additionally refers to statue moving to cattle yard. 
Additions
•	Cornelius & Co. stand & chandeliers (United States section) 
•	Prussia flag on South side of nave (Zollverein section). 
•	Multiple illustrations (photographs and engravings) added.
•	Two more Swiss flags.
•	Arethusa by Frederick Thrupp (British Sculpture Court) 
•	Eve After the Fall by Monti (Austrian Sculpture Court) 
•	Stewart’s cast iron pipes (Machinery at Rest Court, North of Western nave)
•	Gallery “to the staircases” sign now duplicated on all 10 staircases (and wording now appears on both sides). 
•	Various cabinets & stands at gallery level, including: India Rubber & Gutta Percha stand (North West); Switzerland & France (South, East of transept).
•	Various cabinets & stands at ground floor level, including: Hancock stuffed birds stand (North transept); Spain & Portugal (North nave, East of transept); Austrian Leistler Rooms & Russia Court (North of Eastern nave)
•	Leistler bookcase 
•	Banners: surgical instruments (North West gallery)
